description: Legacy assets and cost recovery can block adaptation even when risks are known.
Digital tools can improve efficiency while reducing transparency rights and public trust.
International bodies can agree in principle while failing to align financing responsibility and action.
Rules designed for older systems struggle to govern platforms AI biotechnology and energy transitions.
Participation becomes fragile when public voice is not connected to decision rights or budgets.
Foresight products fail when not linked to fiscal authority staffing and implementation.
Preparedness lessons fade after crises when attention funding and staff continuity decline.
Local offices face expanding mandates without stable funding or technical support.
